results.detail: Hijri dates depend on the calendar convention. Waqt shows Umm al-Qura by default: a deliberate project choice, not a claim that every community follows it. Another provider (for example arithmetic-tabular) can legitimately show a different day for the same moment; the Waqt time itself does not change.
